note: Writes hand-checked-case.json for px4_fmm: three local position ticks worked out from FlightModeManager::Run / start_flight_task / generateTrajectorySetpoint (FlightModeManager.cpp: 75-372) and FlightTaskDescend (FlightTaskDescend.cpp:40-80), PX4's default parameters. Inputs: armed in Descend (nav state 12) with commander's flags for it (auto, climb rate, attitude, rates, allocation; control_mode.cpp:102-108), a valid estimate (vz 0.1 m/s, heading 0.25 rad), takeoff status flight (5). Step 0 (t = 1 s): the first local position runs the module (interval 20 ms, :66); nav state 12 starts Descend (:236-241). FlightTask::activate resets every setpoint to NaN; Descend::update: vz is finite, so velocity z = MPC_LAND_SPEED = 0.7 and acceleration z NaN; no stick nudging (MPC_LAND_RC_HELP 0), so acceleration xy = 0, yawspeed NaN, yaw = heading 0.25. Constraints: MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP 3, MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN 1.5, no takeoff (FlightTask.cpp:210-214). The gear is GEAR_DOWN (-1), which differs from the initial GEAR_KEEP, so landing_gear is published. Step 1 (t = 1.0025 s): SubscriptionInterval keeps the average rate, not the spacing: after the run at 1 s its last update is constrain(0 + 20 ms, 1 s - 20 ms, 1 s) = 0.98 s (SubscriptionInterval.cpp:62-66), so 22.5 ms have elapsed and the module runs again: the same setpoint and constraints, stamped 1.0025 s; the gear is unchanged, so landing_gear is not published (its output keeps the last message, flag false). The last update becomes constrain(0.98 s + 20 ms, 0.9825 s, 1.0025 s) = 1 s. Step 2 (t = 1.005 s): 5 ms since 1 s, inside the interval: the module does not run; nothing is published (the outputs keep the last messages, flags false).
